notes: 02: no metadata fetch; title defaults to url when blank, nothing auto-collected. 03: title editable before (save form) and after (edit dialog), but no description field and no auto-collection. 04: url/title/tags editable via PUT; no description or note fields exist. 06: duplicate url is detected and a warning is returned, but a new duplicate row is still created ('Saved it again anyway') — does not converge to editing the existing bookmark. 07: list shows title, url, tags; no description and no favicon. 10: tags entered via plain text input (autocomplete='off'), no datalist/autocomplete of existing tags. 12: search covers only title+url substring; description/note fields do not exist. 14: '#tag' has no special handling, treated as literal substring. 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses parsing. 16: no quoted-phrase handling; quotes searched literally. 17-19: no unread/read-later flag or unread view. 20-21: no multi-select or bulk actions. 22: list is hardcoded newest-first (created_at DESC); no user-selectable sort key. 23: no note field or markdown rendering. 24-25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive support. 26-28: no archive flag, archived view, or reversible-archive vs permanent-delete distinction. 29: no bundle/saved-filter entity. 30-31: no Netscape HTML import or export. 32: no user settings (sort/display/font-size).
